EOMasters Newsletter #022

21/04/2024

Hello EO-Masters!

You might have heard it already. SNAP 10 has been released. 🎉

We had to wait almost two years for this release. If you know wonder if it was worth the wait, I have prepared something for you.

You can read my blog ESA SNAP v10 – What’s new?

or if you want to sit back and watch a video you can follow this one on YouTube:  

If you haven't done yet, you can download SNAP from the STEP website.

The release now allows me to release my plugins as well. So, stay tuned in the coming days.

Let's continue with the latest EO news.

EOMasters News

EOMasters Plugins Are about to Be Released

Since SNAP 10 is now released I can now release my plugins too. IN the coming days they will be available vie the Plugin Manager in SNAP. I'll do some final testing and then they will go online.

You can expect the EOMasters Toolbox and DAVALIEN.

The toolbox will provide a collection of various tools which help to ease the daily work and to save valuable time. DAVALIEN provides an environment for validating EO data. Not only validating the data but also the generating process. If you want to know more, please follow the links.

  • EOM DAVALIEN | EOMasters

  • EOM DAVALIEN | EOMasters

EO and RS News

Access ESA Campaign Data

ESA conducts airborne, ship-borne, balloon-borne, and ground-based campaigns and small satellite field experiments. During these campaign dataset are created and ESA makes them accessible. Now ESA provides a detailed guide on how to access datasets from ESA’s Campaigns.

  • How to access campaign data distributed by ESA - Earth Online

Four new Ideas to Expand Earth Explorer Missions Selected

ESA's Advisory Committee for Earth Observation (ACEO) recommended that four of the 17 bids move ahead to the assessment study phase.

  • CryoRad seeks to improve measurements of polar regions by using a new radiometer to assess ice conditions and sea-surface salinity.

  • ECO aims to track Earth’s energy balance by measuring incoming and outgoing radiation, potentially forecasting climate trends much earlier than existing techniques.

  • Hydroterra+ is designed for geostationary orbit to offer bi-daily data on Europe, the Mediterranean, and northern Africa, utilizing C-band radar to monitor water cycles and tectonic activities.

  • Keystone is set to make pioneering observations of atomic oxygen between 50–150 km altitude, and will monitor atmospheric composition, temperature, and winds to analyze the mesosphere-lower-thermosphere’s dynamics and energy.

  • ESA selects four new Earth Explorer mission ideas

Save the Date! Destination Earth Goes Live

The launch event for the Destination Earth System will be held on Monday 10 June 2024 in the LUMI Supercomputer Center in Kajaani, Finland. It will take place as a hybrid event and everyone can join the live stream.

Destination Earth (DestinE) is the European Commission's flagship program to create a highly realistic digital model of the Earth at a global scale. This model will track, simulate, and forecast the interactions of natural phenomena and human activities.

  • Destination Earth goes live! | Shaping Europe’s digital future (europa.eu)

  • Destination Earth | Shaping Europe’s digital future (europa.eu)

Planet Insights Platform Started

The Planet Insights Platform has recently be announced and it is the all-in-one place for unifying Planet's product portfolio and the power of Sentinel Hub, which has been acquired last year. Combining the analysis-ready Earth data products with cloud-based analytics and tools will allow users to efficiently analyze, stream, and distribute data.

  • Planet Insights Platform Delivers Powerful Tooling for Unlocking Earth Observation Data

  • Planet Insights Platform | Planet

But was it worth the wait? Read in my blog what has changed and what has been added in this version.

If you are using Ubuntu and using the snap package manager, you should be careful when uninstalling SNAP 9. Read these instructions from the developers. See link below

Beyond EO

Preferred Background Noise When Working at Home

When you are working at home, do you like to have some background noise? Maybe some music? Some say they miss the noice in the office when they work at home.

Or do you have children playing in your background and that's enough noise 🙂.

Most of the time I like to work with calm classical music. This helps me to stay focused. But sometimes it needs harder music (pop, rock, metal, rap, ...).

I've recently tried artificial office ambiance sounds. There are several source which can provide you office sounds, or forest sounds. But that's not really for me. I get why some people like it, but I like music more.

I've collceted some source of music which you might like.

The library piano is my favourite.

  • LIBRARY PIANO - Classical Piano Music (youtube.com)

  • myNoise - Background Noises • Ambient Sounds • Relaxing Music

  • Online Background Noises • Relaxing Sounds • Noise Masking

  • Lofi Girl (youtube.com)

Tschüss and Goodbye!

Marco
